'''Mirror, Mirror''' is the 25th expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 6 December 2000. The set consists of 131 cards.

This set is available in 11-card booster packs. There are 30 booster packs in one booster box.

Included in the 131 card set is the ultra-rare First Officer Spock, a handful of Rare+ cards (33% more rare than Rare), and a distribution of Rare, Uncommon and Common cards similar to other Star Trek CCG sets. In '''Mirror, Mirror''', there are more personnel than in any previous Star Trek CCG set, including the "mirror personae" of TOS and Deep Space Nine personnel who've entered the Mirror Universe.

[[Decipher]] issued a double-sided Rules Supplement / Card List sheet inserted in each booster box.

Due to production methods at the time, several cards were produced with a slight curve in them.

This set was noted for the following:
*Introduced the Mirror Universe quadrant, staffing icons, affiliations, and 'crossing over'
*More personnel cards than in any previous expansion set including the "mirror personae" of TOS and DS9 personnel who enter the Mirror Universe
*Distribution of rarity of cards was a bit more fluid compared to previous expansions

==Additional Information==
*'''Mirror, Mirror''' was printed on 121 card sheets by Teagle & Little, USA.
*Each print sheet consisted of an 11 x 11 format.
*The Common/Uncommon print sheet had 2 copies of all common cards, 1 copy of all Uncommon cards, plus 1 copy of the Rare Black Test card for a total of 121 cards (11x11 format).
*The Rare print sheet had 2 copies of the 30 Rare+ cards, 3 copies of the 20 Rare cards, plus 1 copy of the Ultra Rare card for a total of 121 cards (11x11 format).
